name: Crystal Release: Prismatic Dragon of Heaven

system.description:
You manifest a beast made of crystal. By molding your crystal release chakra, you are able to conjure a crystal Dragon. Crystal Dragons are Earthen Artifacts.

The Crystal Dragon has the listed statistics found at the end of this clan on its stat block. It uses your highest jutsu attack bonus or Save DC when an effect calls for it and you command it as a Bonus action.

If you have the Crystal Dragon and other creatures summoned by Shoton Hijutsu, you can command them all separately, as part of the same Bonus action used to command the Crystal Dragon.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above A-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the Dragons hit points by 20.

Crystal Dragon

Large Construct, unaligned

Armor Class 22 + 2 For every rank above A-Rank, DR 6 +2 for every rank above A-Rank

Hit Points 80 + 20 for every rank above A-Rank

Speed 40 ft fly

| | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save |

| STR | +6 | +9 | CON | +9 | +9 | WIS | +0 | +0 |

| DEX | +2 | +5 | INT | -5 | -5 | CHA | +5 | -5 |

Damage Immunities Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing.

Condition Immunities All Mental, All Sensory, Stunned, Petrified, envenomed.

Senses Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10

Abrasive. When a crystal dragon takes damage from a melee attack, the attacking creature must make a Constitution saving throw, gaining a rank of Bleed on a failure.

Crystalline Sovereignty. All creatures that are summoned as a result of a Shoton Hijutsu, within 20 feet of the Crystal Dragon, except the Dragon itself, gains +2 DR

Attacks

Multiattack. The Crystal Dragon can attack 2 times. Once with its Bite and once with its tail sweep.

Bite. melee Weapon Attack: reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 4d6+6 Earth damage. Once per turn, a creature hit by this attack must make a Strength Saving throw. On a failed save they are Bruised.

Tail Sweep. The Crystal Dragon sweeps its tail in a 10-foot cone, in front of itself, forcing all creatures in range to make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6+6 earth damage, and being knocked Prone on a failure, or half as much damage on a success.

Crystal Breath (Recharge 5-6): The Crystal Dragon exhales a beam of crystalline energy, compressed into a 90-foot long, 5-foot-wide beam of earth chakra, forcing everyone in range to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take 8d6 earth damage, and gain 2 ranks of Crystalize as their body is forcibly shifted into a crystalline molecular structure.
